shortBio.en: Pixies frontman (Charles Thompson); scream-quiet dynamics and surreal lyric.
shortBio.zh: Pixies 主唱（Charles Thompson）；尖叫-安静动态与超现实歌词。

body.en:
Born 1965. Writes Surfer Rosa/Doolittle quiet-loud forms. Screamo bark vs clean verse. Solo as Frank Black after 1993 split; reunions later.

Song form is the export Nirvana cites.
body.zh:
1965 年生。写 Surfer Rosa/Doolittle 强弱曲式。嘶吼吠叫对干净主歌。1993 解散后以 Frank Black 独唱；后重聚。

曲式是 Nirvana 引用的输出。
